title: GTA 6 x Miami Heat Vice City Merchandise Announced
description: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games and the Miami Heat have launched a GTA 6-themed Vice City Collection at the Miami Heat online store, with items like tees and hats selling out quickly and more expected on November 18.

sections.heading: Vice City Collection drops at Miami Heat store
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that the Miami Heat have teamed up with Rockstar Games for a GTA 6-themed merchandise drop called the Vice City Collection. The items are available now through the Miami Heat online store.

According to the report, the collection includes Vice City-branded clothes ranging from t-shirts to hats. RockstarINTEL notes that items began selling out in certain sizes within minutes of the shadow drop.

sections.heading: Availability and planned in-person event
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL says the collection follows the NBA franchise's earlier announcement that it will rebrand for one night only on the eve of GTA VI's launch. The merchandise is expected to ship within 5-6 weeks.

More items are expected to be available on November 18 at the Kaseya Center. RockstarINTEL also mentions that signing up for the free Heat Store Insider program gives free U.S. shipping on orders over $99.
